name: "In That Top"| Short Film by Aditi Mittal
description:
The film as part of Democracy 2024 Financial Times series is crucial as polls are held in over 64 countries to choose future leaders, it's important we address it and bring attention to it.

 I am honoured to be a part of this series with legends like Margaret Atwood, Elif Shafak, Lola Shoneyin.
